name: Layout
summary: The skeleton of a page: a header, a side column, the content and a footer. It draws the rules that separate them and leaves the surfaces to the page behind it.
summaryZh: 页面的骨架:页头、侧栏、内容和页脚。它只画把这些区域分开的线,底色留给页面本身。

variants.name: Stacked
variants.note: The side column sits above the content instead of beside it.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default column width needs no modifier class.

states.name: Aligned to the start
states.note: The column and the content stand at the top of the row.

states.name: Aligned to the centre
states.note: The column and the content stand in the middle of the row.

states.name: Aligned to the end
states.note: The column and the content stand at the bottom of the row.

parts.name: Header
parts.note: The band across the top. It is a <header>, so it is a landmark.

parts.name: Body
parts.note: The row that holds the side column and the content. It is the part the stacked variant turns.

parts.name: Aside
parts.note: The column beside the content. It is an <aside>, so it is a landmark.

parts.name: Main
parts.note: The content. It is a <main>, so it is the landmark the rest of the page is read against.

parts.name: Footer
parts.note: The band at the bottom. It is a <footer>.

props.name: direction
props.description: Whether the side column stands beside the content or above it. The horizontal form is the base class on its own; the stacked form adds um-layout--stacked.
props.descriptionZh: 侧栏是站在内容旁边还是排在内容上面。横向就是只写基类;上下堆叠再加上 um-layout--stacked。

props.name: size
props.description: The width of the side column.

props.name: align
props.description: How the side column and the content stand against each other across the row. The stretched row needs no modifier class.
props.descriptionZh: 侧栏和内容在整行里怎么对齐。拉伸的那一档不需要修饰类。

a11y.notes: The parts are the landmarks themselves: a <header>, an <aside>, a <main> and a <footer>. A screen reader can jump from one landmark to the next, which is the fastest way through a long page. There is one <main> per page, so the content of the layout is the main landmark and nothing else may claim it. Label the aside and the header when there is more than one of either.
a11y.notesZh: 这几个部件本身就是地标:<header>、<aside>、<main> 和 <footer>。读屏可以从一个地标跳到下一个,这是翻长页面最快的办法。一个页面只有一个 <main>,所以布局里的内容就是那个主地标,别的元素不要再抢。当页头或侧栏不止一个的时候,给它们起名字。

examples.title: Header, side column, content, footer
examples.description: The usual arrangement. The regions are separated by rules rather than by fills, so the page behind the layout keeps one surface instead of carrying a stack of translucent ones.
examples.descriptionZh: 常见的样子。各个区域靠线分开而不是靠底色,所以布局后面的页面只留一层表面,而不是叠着一摞半透明的层。

notes: The layout paints no surface of its own. A frame that owns a surface paints it and the thing inside the frame paints nothing, and the layout has no business owning the page's background — the page behind it does. The regions are separated with rules instead, so the skeleton reads as a skeleton and the page keeps one background all the way down.
notesZh: 布局自己不画任何表面。谁拥有一层表面,谁就画它,而里面的东西就什么都不画;页面背后的底色属于页面,不属于布局。各个区域改用线来分开,于是骨架还是骨架的样子,页面从头到尾只有一层背景。
